name: io.github.mysleekdesigns/crawlforge-mcp-server
description: Web scraping, crawling, deep research & autonomous extraction — 29 MCP tools, clean Markdown/JSON

environmentVariables.name: CRAWLFORGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CrawlForge API key for authentication and usage/credit tracking. Get a free key at https://www.crawlforge.dev

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO account login. Optional — only needed to enable the serp_rank tool (real Google organic rank lookups); billed separately to the caller's own DataForSEO account.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO account password. Optional — only needed to enable the serp_rank tool.
